ImageDescription.value: The inauguration plaque (right) and the logo of Tebet Eco Park on its north side, Jakarta Indonesia. Tebet Eco Park was previously named Tebet Honda Park, which was revitalized between 2021-2022. The park was reinaugurated on 24 April 2022.
